evidence.mechanism: shot-08s: bottom-row strips curl into full arcs while the top two rows stay upright and a middle row is tilted; by shot-20s the arcs open and the top rows still hold a curve, so the base-to-tip lag reads on screen.
evidence.ambition: shot-08s: 48 strips in an 8x6 grid, each a nested segment chain with pale skin and dark fiber lines; one flat layer with no lighting, simulation or secondary rendering idea beyond the strips and tiles.
evidence.craft: shot-02s: cream radial ground with ochre edges and upright rust strips with dark graphite bases; the strips are thin and small at 1280x720, and by shot-08s the tile panels behind them fade into the ground with muddy edges.
evidence.distinctness: shot-02s: 48 identical rust strips on a cream ground in an 8x6 grid; by shot-20s they form a central diagonal cluster, a subject not in the anchors (sky birds, climate spiral, chart waterfall, two-pendulum beam).
evidence.polish: shot-02s: the upright grid fills the frame as a composed start; by shot-20s the cluster pulls back into a cream margin and the open-to-closed gradient differs from shot-02s, so the piece resolves.

pairwise_justification: No median archive yet: the median block is NONE, so there is no head-to-head comparison to make.

critique.change: Enlarge the strips so the arcs at shot-08s fill about twice their current cell size; the segment chain and base-to-tip lag are too small to read at thumbnail scale.
Add the brown-tissue haze behind each strip from the brief, brightening and dimming with the wave, so the frame has a second rendering idea beyond the strips and tiles.
Remove the small label 'PINUS SCALE / BASAL HINGE / 48 x 12' at shot-02s and let the bend wave carry the identity of the piece.
